class_definitions.fixed_source_policy_only: A fixed user-supplied policy input exists, but canonical Plans and runtime implementation are not proven by this census.
class_definitions.proposed_ledger_only: The behavior is accepted in noncanonical ledger/source memory and has not been compiled into a canonical owner.
class_definitions.canonical_plan_only_implementation_gated: Current canonical prose exists, but no executable production route or integration evidence proves the behavior.
class_definitions.isolated_fixture_only: A test-only fixture or harness design exists; it cannot prove product integration and may not be runnable under the current controller.
class_definitions.runnable_current_deterministic: A current nonsemantic deterministic check or specialized harness exists; its result is limited to that exact check and is not prompt-restriction enforcement evidence.
